Delhi Police Cordon Off Protest Area, Issue Traffic Advisories

Delhi Police imposed Section 144 in the New Delhi area and issued traffic advisories due to ongoing student protests over the alleged NEET paper leak. Metro entry gates at Rajiv Chowk, Mandi House, and Central Secretariat stations were reopened after being closed. Some reports indicated police may withdraw FIRs as the CJP-led agitation concluded. Liquor shops in Delhi were also directed to close by 8 pm over the weekend due to the protests.
